newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on profit-taking by small investors, and brokers said the market could remain depressed for the next couple of days.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed down 26.55 points, or 1.39 percent, at 1,869.83 in turnover of 47.3 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. Of 84 traded issues, 62 lost and 19 gained.

"The investors are cautious in a falling market," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps lost 469 taka to 4,711, Beximco Pharmaceuticals shed 8.0 to 188 and A.M.C.I.Pran was up 15 to 754. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
